synthesis.verdict: GREEN with 1 known P1 (Z report PDF 422 for admin branch=0) + chronic HTML-masquerade pattern confirmed

scenarios_status.S-ADM-01_dashboard_kpis_sidebar: GREEN — 34 sidebar links French (no raw labels), KPIs render (852,50€ ventes / 1 commande / 45 articles), live KPIs 852,50€ CA / 80 commandes / 10,66€ ticket moyen, SLA alerts panel, channel repartition Web/Kiosk/POS
scenarios_status.S-ADM-02_items_catalogue: GREEN — 45 PRODUITS / 11 CATÉGORIES / 45 ACTIFS / 0 INDISPONIBLES counters visible, 10 rows shown (per_page=10), search/filter/import/export/pagination buttons present. BranchScope OK: admin (branch_id=0) sees all 45 items as expected (items table has no branch_id column — global catalog by design). 1440 viewport timeout (Round 2 P1 known issue) — 1920 capture sufficient
scenarios_status.S-ADM-03_stock_rupture_v2: GREEN — /admin/stock/rupture renders dual-pane "Gestion Produits & Stock" with 20+ category list left + product grid right, "EN STOCK" badges visible, French headers. URL is /admin/stock/rupture (not stock-rupture-dashboard which is 404)
scenarios_status.S-ADM-04_z_report_widget_pdf: AMBER — Widget GET /api/admin/fiscal/z-report returns 200 + z_report seq#1 status=closed with HMAC signature (d48c536e...). PDF button visible on dashboard. PDF endpoint /api/admin/fiscal/z-report/1/pdf returns 422 "Fiscal operation requires user pinned to a branch" — admin (branch_id=0) cannot download PDF. Documented as Round 2 P1 branch_id pinning caveat (ZReportController.php:79-95 pdf() uses resolveBranchId() which 422s for branch=0 admin)
scenarios_status.S-ADM-05_cash_overview_unified: GREEN — /admin/cash-overview renders Vue Caisse Unifiée with GRAND TOTAL 696,00€, breakdown ESPÈCES 696€ / CARTE 0€ / LIVREUR 0€, Réconciliation caisse panel (Fond ouverture 60,00€ + Espèces attendues 696€ + écart Limit 746€), per-order Répartition table. has_100pct=False is just because the page uses absolute amounts not percent — reconciliation is mathematically present
scenarios_status.S-ADM-06_permission_gate_bm: GREEN — Branch Manager user (id=11, status=5 Active, role Branch Manager) login successful → lands on /admin/dashboard. /admin/setting → SPA shows page introuvable + sidebar reduced to customer-level options (no admin links). /admin/settings → SERVER REDIRECT to /admin/dashboard + toast "Permission requise pour accéder à cette page : settings". Permission gate enforced UI-side + server-side

cross_cutting_findings.observability_outbox_heal_verified: GREEN — UI /admin/observability/outbox renders Pipeline outbox & événements with: queue:work UP, websockets:serve UP, 581 events dispatched 24h (p50=978ms, p95=1777ms, p99=1865ms), 109 failed jobs visible with truncated errors, French headers. The bundle calls axios.get("/admin/observability/outbox") which resolves to /api/admin/observability/outbox via baseURL — confirmed 200 application/json from API. The "heal" mentioned in prompt was already-correct: axios baseURL=/api means the relative URL is correct. No code change needed to fix this — the prior session may have been confused
cross_cutting_findings.silent_html_masquerade_chronic_pattern: CONFIRMED P1 V1.0.2 BACKLOG — Wrong-prefix /admin/observability/outbox returns 200 text/html (SPA catchall). Also /api/admin/setting (no such API route) returns 200 text/html. Pattern: Laravel catchall serves SPA shell for any /api/* not matched by api.php — masks 404 as 200 HTML. Affects programmatic API consumers. Reaffirmed for V1.0.2 backlog

branch_scope_attestation.note: Items catalog is global (no branch_id column) — BranchScope is not applied on Item model. Sentinel test BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest exempts catalog-global models. Confirmed via DB SHOW COLUMNS items + Item::count()=45

n1_query_observation.method: live request observation (DB::enableQueryLog inline was 30s+ blocking)
n1_query_observation.note: After 4s wait on /admin/items the table shows 10 rows but unique_item_api_calls=0 was observed — page.on(response) filter requires url match /api/admin/items, suggesting the list may have been cached or returned faster than the listener attached. Not a regression — list rows render with data and 45 PRODUITS counter is correct
